device_name: CREO DLX Large Diameter Rod System

specs.Features: Fenestrated , Polyaxial Head , Extended Reduction Head Tabs

description:
CREO DLX: 6.0 and 6.35mm Large diameter rod system
The CREO DLX by Globus Medical is a large diameter rod system utilizing the 6.0 and 6.35mm diameter rods. This system is primarily intended for thoracolumbar fixations where complex spinal pathologies require increased strength of the construct such as complex deformity, tumor, and trauma. The CREO DLX system also has a fenestrated screw which comes preloaded with polyaxial head.
Screw Options:
DLX polyaxial screw:
DLX Dual Outer Diameter (DOD) Screws
DLX Uniplanar Screw
DLX Fenestrated Screws
